purpose: Single out a minimum action or one especially important item.
keywords: Even when busy, I at least eat breakfast.
I do not know what will happen, but I will at least apply.
Please keep this secret, at least.
restrictions: Focus depends on context: at least this, or this in particular.
mistake: Do not interpret は as adding another item.
